name: Brandon Ragan Project
bio: The Brandon Ragan Project is a funk and blues band from Ventura. Brandon Ragan is a saxophonist from Alabama with a background in gospel jazz who now calls Downtown Ventura home. The band plays regularly at Tony's Pizzaria in Ventura.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from brandonragan.com and @thebrandonraganproject5000.
